purpose: 2025 blind evaluation of the frozen Branch01 Candidate A model, over the exact same 8,736 origin x horizon rows used by the corrected Stage 8.1 2025 blind evaluation. No retraining, no tuning, no feature/model modification. No comparison/winner declared.
architecture_note: Branch01 uses one 18-feature vector per ORIGIN (causal SW_IN lookback/lag/stats, astronomical position, clear-sky reference at origin) and its MultiOutputRegressor emits all 24 horizon predictions from that single vector -- no horizon-specific NWP input, unlike Stage 8.1's per-(origin,horizon) feature rows.
causality_note: sw_in_lag_0h is the actual SW_IN observed AT the origin (known at forecast time, not future data). Under this repo's horizon_hour=1 == forecast_start+0h convention, this coincides numerically with the h=1 target timestamp -- an architectural property of Branch01 as a nowcast-anchored persistence model, not a future-data leak. No actual SW_IN value from AFTER an origin was used as a feature for that origin's predictions.
nmae_definition: mae / mean(actual) * 100, identical to the corrected Stage 8.1 2025 evaluation
